name: n1_client_calls_a_v2_method
note: A client that negotiated 1 against an N-1 daemon still reaches this daemon's v1 surfaces; a v2-only method is refused before it runs, naming the version it needs so the client can tell 'restart onto the newer engine' apart from 'no such method'.

name: n1_client_calls_a_plugin_method
note: The whole Integrations surface is v2, so an N-1 daemon refuses it as one: the client says the daemon needs updating rather than drawing an empty pane.

name: plugin_row_without_optional_fields
note: Every optional field on a plugin row absent at once: no account, no workspaces, no settings, no access profiles, no remote disclosure, and no leading verb. A client renders the row from what is present and never infers a state from a null.
